baseline: no skill (null), plus a 49-line lean variant — see README.md

evals.name: legacy-index-consolidation
evals.expected_output: Recognises the two exhaustive CLAUDE.md index tables as a single systemic pattern per file rather than one finding per derivable row. Does not demand more index coverage.

evals.name: enumeration-drift
evals.expected_output: Cross-references the README env var table against .env.example (3 documented, 6 real) and the commands list against package.json scripts (3 documented, 5 real). Names the source file it diffed against.

evals.name: lean-docs-no-false-positives
evals.expected_output: Stays quiet. The table-free CLAUDE.md of commands and invariants is correct, and the README already has prerequisites, expected output, and troubleshooting. Should not invent findings or demand an index table.

evals.name: messy-mixed-defects-and-traps
evals.expected_output: Finds the real defects (npm run setup absent from package.json, broken docs/DEPLOY.md link, services list documenting 2 of 4) without touching MEMORY.md, without escalating anything to P1, and treating the unfinished Dockerfile as a docs defect only insofar as the README promises it works.
